text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Inari! Has the soba arrived yet?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh!! That was YOUR doing?! A huge package 
suddenly showed up at my room, and I had 
no clue what was going on!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's a birthday present from Turbo! I 
heard you liked soba, so I sent you a 
really fancy set packed with tons of it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Are you happy? You're happy, right!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...Turbo, I appreciate the thought, 
really... but that's buckwheat flour."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Buckwheat flour? ...Wait, don't tell me 
it's not actually soba noodles...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, I guess you could call it soba, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodneeeess!! I thought Inari wasn't 
gonna get to eat her soba!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you're right. There ain't no 
problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Turbo. Only, it's a bit too much 
for one person to eat.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll treat you to some too, Turbo! Eat up, 
as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you sure? Turbo's gonna eat a ton, 
then!
